# Outposts

Player outposts on planets: buildable, saveable per-character bases with an Outpost Console, spawn options, POIs, raids, farming and outpost gizmos. Design only so far; see `OUTPOSTS_DESIGN.md` for the design and `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` for the build order, one pull request per step. `research/` holds the code-reading notes the design was written from (Nova colony_fabricator, the Planets-and-cracking branch, persistence, spawning, POIs) and the workflow scripts that drafted, reviewed and revised it.
